Image 3 is the current ORIGINAL GOLD COSMIC S brand asset: place this existing emblem faithfully as a supporting insert in the upper-right corner; do NOT redesign it, do NOT draw a spider, no invented logo. All references are supporting inputs, not images to overwrite. Make a cohesive spectacular original game campaign scene with real depth, dramatic subject pose, premium high-end 3D/painted illustration finish, vivid luminous highlights (not a predominantly black poster). Keep the protagonist huge and biologically faithful to the named Pokémon. assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create a NEW complete vertical 1024x1536 high-end cinematic Portuguese promotional poster for the Spidey Pokémon GO app.
Input 1 is the OFFICIAL GIRATINA ORIGIN FORME anatomy reference, the decisive character identity. Input 2 is only the accepted Pawniard campaign style/finish reference; do not copy its Pokémon, information panels, or layout. Input 3 is the EXISTING ORIGINAL cosmic gold S brand emblem, a supporting insert; reuse it faithfully, do not invent a replacement.
Primary request: a spectacular epic Origin Forme Giratina in the Distortion World, floating above fractured stone pillars and a luminous violet cosmic sea. Give the entire character an elegant dynamic curved serpentine pose and a coherent immersive scene with scale, depth and dramatic violet/cyan/gold lighting, polished game key-art finish and large crisp mobile-readable typography.
CRITICAL CHARACTER IDENTITY: reproduce the anatomy of input 1 faithfully in three-dimensional cinematic rendering. Long legless grey segmented serpentine body, black bands with red stripes only on the FRONT UNDERSIDE of the neck/body. The SIDES and BACK are predominantly pale grey. Exact gold side armor around a flat narrow skull with grey forehead dome, small red eyes and two long curved downward gold mandibles. Do not convert the head into the three-spike high crown of Altered Forme. SIX long, slender BLACK shadow streamers, three per side of upper back, each ending in a SMALL flat red triangular tip; retain long ribbon silhouette, not huge tubular arms or red claws. Small separate grey-and-gold side body fins toward tail match reference. Body tapers and curls into a tail with grey fins/gold tips as shown. No feet, legs, bat wings, huge horns, fangs, oversized claws, invented armor, or hybrid form. Show the character large and readable, with its whole head and long curled tail visible. Let the six streamers fan behind without covering text.
Upper left header exact "SPIDEY" above "POKÉMON GO". Upper right supporting original gold cosmic S insert from image 3, modest scale in an uncluttered area.
Exact main text integrated at bottom in this order: "REIDES DE 5 ESTRELAS", "GIRATINA", "FORMA ORIGEM", "28 DE OUTUBRO A 3 DE NOVEMBRO", "Prepare sua equipe para as reides!".
Tiny readable footer: "Fonte: Leek Duck • comunidade" and "SEMPRE UM PASSO À FRENTE".
Typography: enormous gold GIRATINA and luminous white/violet FORMA ORIGEM, dates crisp in a restrained integrated band. Keep cinematic artistry dominant. No extra dates, hours, characters, bonuses, shiny claims, CP tables or invented facts. No SpideyNexus word, no spider emblem, no dashboard, no generic flat background, no framed screenshot. The character must match the official reference, with costume/anatomy taking precedence over stylistic spectacle.
